With 41 days remaining until the primary, updated polling would provide voters and observers with current data on the state of the race.

Voters are the customers.  

Not your favorite candidate or a friend.

Florida Voters!

posts.text:
Hollywood should be studying ROI as much as raw box office.

Obsession: $750k budget → $427M worldwide (600x return)

Backrooms: $10m budget → $363M worldwide (36x return) 

Meanwhile:

Supergirl: $250m budget → $110M worldwide (so far but declining) 

Numbers don’t lie. 

It’s not about how much money you spend or which major celebrities you have in movies.  

Tell good stories and entertain.
